title: Co-Founder & Interim Chair
bio: Co-founder of Bluffline, Inc. and interim executive director of WUWF. A strategist, storyteller, and place-maker with a background spanning journalism, strategic communications, urban planning, and nonprofit leadership, T.S. has worked on everything from multimillion-dollar public infrastructure projects to community-driven branding initiatives, and has helped secure funding for parks, greenways, and transformative public spaces. An award-winning journalist with a Gold Medal for Public Service from the Florida Society of News Editors, T.S. believes progress happens when people find common cause and come together on common ground—through shared narratives and shared spaces.
